name: Amazon Redshift
sku: Amazon Redshift, provisioned clusters and Redshift Serverless.

store.warehouse.note: A fully managed, petabyte-scale data warehouse, available as provisioned clusters or as Redshift Serverless, which scales capacity automatically and charges nothing when idle.

serve.query-engine.note: SQL queries run from the built-in query editor v2 or from existing BI tools and SQL clients.

bands.note: Role-based access control grants permissions to roles rather than individual objects, and can delegate tasks that used to need a superuser.
Dynamic data masking policies hide, obfuscate or pseudonymise column values at query time for specific users or roles, including conditional cell-level masking, without changing the stored data.

presentation.tagline: Managed columnar data warehouse with a serverless option.
